# Reverse

Reverses the order of the elements of an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Reverse(items)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to reverse, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding the elements of items from the last to the first. Never null.

## Example

`Reverse([1, 2, 3])` returns `[3, 2, 1]`.
